column1: # Photosynthesis proton-pump stoichiometry
# Source: Generate_Core_ModelTemplate.py lines 505-524 (hard-coded; lifted here)
# Adds the proton motive force across the thylakoid membrane (compartment 'y')
# from the stroma (compartment 'd') for PS II and Cytochrome b6f.
# These additions are at the COMPLEX level because the same template reaction
# (rxn20632_y or rxn20595_y) may be referenced by multiple complexes, but the
# proton flux is a property of the catalysed reaction itself.
# Schema:  enzyme \t action \t field \t value \t [extra_1] \t [extra_2]
# Actions used here:
#   ASSIGN direction <dir>          - sets the reaction direction (existing)
#   UPDATE stoichiometry cpd coeff  - upserts an existing reagent's coefficient (existing)
#   ADD    reagent cpd coeff [cpt]  - PROPOSED: appends a brand-new reagent;
#                                     blank cpt = reaction's home compartment
# rxn20632_y is owned by two complexes (Photosystem II + Cytochrome b559); the
# proton-pump additions should be applied wherever the reaction lands, so the
# Generate script needs to merge ADD-reagent records across all complexes that
# own a shared base reaction.
# ---- Block 1: Photosystem II (rxn20632_y) — pump 4 H+ from stroma to lumen
Photosystem II protein D1 PsbA
Photosystem II protein D1 PsbA
# ---- Block 2: Cytochrome b6-f (rxn20595_y) — 2 H+ pumped in from stroma,
# 4 H+ released into lumen (2 pumped + 2 from plastoquinol oxidation)
Cytochrome b6-f complex PetA, apocytochrome f (EC 7.1.1.6)
